API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser ManagementDepartment Resource Add Department
Department Resource Add Department
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/departments

Adds a department for an organization. To learn more, see Adding Departments.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Department information

name
string
REQUIRED

Department name

idpId
int64

Identity provider (IdP) ID. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

comments
string

Additional information about this department. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

deleted
boolean

List of deleted departments

Default value: false
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Department ID

name
string
REQUIRED

Department name

idpId
int64

Identity provider (IdP) ID. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

comments
string

Additional information about this department. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

deleted
boolean

List of deleted departments

Default value: false
